text_en: Now in those days Judith heard about these things: she was the daughter of Merari son of Ox son of Joseph son of Oziel son of Elkiah son of Ananias son of Gideon son of Raphain son of Ahitub son of Elijah son of Hilkiah son of Eliab son of Nathanael son of Salamiel son of Sarasadai son of Israel.
text_cn: 在那几天，默辣黎的女儿友弟德也听说了这些事。──默辣黎是敖克斯的儿子，敖克斯是若瑟的儿子，若瑟是敖齐耳的儿子，敖齐耳是厄耳基雅的儿子，厄耳基雅是阿纳尼雅的儿子，阿纳尼雅是基德红的儿子，基德红是辣法因的儿子，辣法因是阿希托布的儿子，阿希托布是厄里雅的儿子，厄里雅是希耳基雅的儿子，希耳基雅是厄里雅布的儿子，厄里雅布是纳塔纳耳的儿子，纳塔纳耳是撒拉米耳的儿子，撒拉米耳是撒辣撒待的儿子，撒辣撒待是西默盎的儿子，西默盎是以色列的儿子。 ──

text_en: Her husband Manasseh, who belonged to her tribe and family, had died during the barley harvest.
text_cn: 她的丈夫默纳舍与她同支派又同家族， 是在收割大麦时死的；

text_en: For as he stood overseeing those who were binding sheaves in the field, he was overcome by the burning heat, and took to his bed and died in his town Bethulia. So they buried him with his ancestors in the field between Dothan and Balamon.
text_cn: 他在田间监督工人捆麦穗时，不料头部中暑，一病不起，死在拜突里雅本城；人将他葬在多堂及巴拉孟之间的祖茔（yíng）里。

text_en: Judith remained as a widow for three years and four months
text_cn: 这时友弟德居家守寡，已有三年零四个月。

text_en: at home where she set up a tent for herself on the roof of her house. She put sackcloth around her waist and dressed in widow’s clothing.
text_cn: 她在屋顶上，搭了一个帐幕， 腰束苦带，身穿寡妇衣饰。

text_en: She fasted all the days of her widowhood, except the day before the sabbath and the sabbath itself, the day before the new moon and the day of the new moon, and the festivals and days of rejoicing of the house of Israel.
text_cn: 除了安息前日与安息日，月朔前日与月朔，以及以色列家的节期与庆典外， 在她居寡期内，天天禁食。

text_en: She was beautiful in appearance, and was very lovely to behold. Her husband Manasseh had left her gold and silver, men and women slaves, livestock, and fields; and she maintained this estate.
text_cn: 她的容貌姣美，艳丽好看。她的丈夫默纳舍，留下了不少金银、奴婢、牲畜与田产，她坚守遗业，

text_en: No one spoke ill of her, for she feared God with great devotion.
text_cn: 很敬畏天主，所以说她一句坏话的人也没有。

text_en: When Judith heard the harsh words spoken by the people against the ruler, because they were faint for lack of water, and when she heard all that Uzziah said to them, and how he promised them under oath to surrender the town to the Assyrians after five days,
text_cn: 她听说百姓因为缺水，精神颓唐，向首长提出了严重的抗议。友弟德又听说，敖齐雅向他们所说的话，如何向他们发誓，五天以后，必将城池交给亚述人。

text_en: she sent her maid, who was in charge of all she possessed, to summon Uzziah and Chabris and Charmis, the elders of her town.
text_cn: 她便打发自己管家的使女，去召请城里的长老加布黎和加尔米来。

text_en: They came to her, and she said to them: “Listen to me, rulers of the people of Bethulia! What you have said to the people today is not right; you have even sworn and pronounced this oath between God and you, promising to surrender the town to our enemies unless the Lord turns and helps us within so many days.
text_cn: 他们一来到，友弟德就对他们说：“拜突里雅居民的首长，请听我说！你们今天在百姓前说的话，实在不对；同时竟然对天主发誓，说五天以后，上主若不来援救，就将城池交给敌人。

text_en: Who are you to put God to the test today, and to set yourselves up in the place of God in human affairs?
text_cn: 你们是什么人，今日竟敢试探天主，在人类中竟居天主之上？

text_en: You are putting the Lord Almighty to the test, but you will never learn anything!
text_cn: 如今你们尽管试验全能的上主罢！可是你们始终一无所知！

text_en: You cannot plumb the depths of the human heart or understand the workings of the human mind; how do you expect to search out God, who made all these things, and find out his mind or comprehend his thought? No, my brothers, do not anger the Lord our God.
text_cn: 你们既不能探究人的心曲，又不能明悉人明悟中的思念，如何能探究那创造万有的天主，知道他的心思，认清他的旨意？断乎不能！兄弟们，不可触怒上主我们的天主！

text_en: For if he does not choose to help us within these five days, he has power to protect us within any time he pleases, or even to destroy us in the presence of our enemies.
text_cn: 如果他在五天内，不肯前来施救，他仍有权力在他愿意的时日保护我们，或在我们仇敌前将我们消灭。

text_en: Do not try to bind the purposes of the Lord our God; for God is not like a human being, to be threatened, or like a mere mortal, to be won over by pleading.
text_cn: 你们没有要求保证的权利，而强迫上主，我们的天主，改变旨意，因为天主不同人一样可以受威胁，或如人子一样可以受支配。

text_en: Therefore, while we wait for his deliverance, let us call upon him to help us, and he will hear our voice, if it pleases him.
text_cn: 为此，我们只有等待他的救援，呼求他来援助；如果他愿意，必会俯听我们的呼声。

text_en: “For never in our generation, nor in these present days, has there been any tribe or family or people or town of ours that worships gods made with hands, as was done in days gone by.
text_cn: 何况，我们这一代从来没有，且今日我们也没有一支派，一家族，一村庄，一城市，像昔日一样敬拜人造的神像。

text_en: That was why our ancestors were handed over to the sword and to pillage, and so they suffered a great catastrophe before our enemies.
text_cn: 昔日为了这事，我们的祖先曾被刀斩、劫掠，在敌人前，惨遭灭亡。

text_en: But we know no other god but him, and so we hope that he will not disdain us or any of our nation.
text_cn: 如今我们除了恭敬天主外，不认识别的神，所以也盼望他不会忽略我们，及我们同族的任何人。

text_en: For if we are captured, all Judea will be captured and our sanctuary will be plundered; and he will make us pay for its desecration with our blood.
text_cn: 如果我们投降，全犹太也必投降，我们的圣所必遭抢掠。对他们受的污辱，上主必向我们追讨血债；

text_en: The slaughter of our kindred and the captivity of the land and the desolation of our inheritance—all this he will bring on our heads among the Gentiles, wherever we serve as slaves; and we shall be an offense and a disgrace in the eyes of those who acquire us.
text_cn: 同胞被屠杀，国土被掠夺，祖业遭废弃，都要归咎于将散居在异民中为奴的我们，我们就成为那主宰我们者的讥笑凌辱的对象了。

text_en: For our slavery will not bring us into favor, but the Lord our God will turn it to dishonor.
text_cn: 因为我们投降，并不会转祸为福，上主我们的天主，必因此使我们蒙受羞辱。

text_en: “Therefore, my brothers, let us set an example for our kindred, for their lives depend upon us, and the sanctuary—both the temple and the altar—rests upon us.
text_cn: 兄弟们！如今我们应为同胞做好榜样，因为他们的性命系于我们，圣所、圣殿和祭坛，也赖我们来维护；

text_en: In spite of everything let us give thanks to the Lord our God, who is putting us to the test as he did our ancestors.
text_cn: 为了这一切，我们要感谢上主，我们的天主，因为他考验我们，像考验我们的祖先一样。

text_en: Remember what he did with Abraham, and how he tested Isaac, and what happened to Jacob in Syrian Mesopotamia, while he was tending the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother.
text_cn: 请你们回忆他对亚巴郎所作的，又怎样考验了依撒格；看看雅各伯在叙利亚的美索不达米亚替他舅父放羊时，有了什么遭遇。

text_en: For he has not tried us with fire, as he did them, to search their hearts, nor has he taken vengeance on us; but the Lord scourges those who are close to him in order to admonish them. ”
text_cn: 原来他锻炼他们，乃是为考验他们的心；上主也这样鞭责我们，并不是为惩罚，乃是为警戒与他亲近的人。”

text_en: Then Uzziah said to her, “All that you have said was spoken out of a true heart, and there is no one who can deny your words.
text_cn: 敖齐雅对她说：“你说的这一切，都是出于好心，谁也不会反对你的话。

text_en: Today is not the first time your wisdom has been shown, but from the beginning of your life all the people have recognized your understanding, for your heart’s disposition is right.
text_cn: 你的智慧，并不是今天初次才显露出来，而是自你幼年，众百姓就已赏识你的见解，知道你的心怎样良善。

text_en: But the people were so thirsty that they compelled us to do for them what we have promised, and made us take an oath that we cannot break.
text_cn: 无奈，百姓渴得要命，逼迫我们，要按我们对他们所说的去行，而且还胁迫我们，发了我们不可违犯的誓。

text_en: Now since you are a God-fearing woman, pray for us, so that the Lord may send us rain to fill our cisterns. Then we will no longer feel faint from thirst. ”
text_cn: 如今请你为我们祈祷，因为你是虔诚的妇女，上主必降甘霖，注满我们的池沼，使我们不再渴得发晕。”

text_en: Then Judith said to them, “Listen to me. I am about to do something that will go down through all generations of our descendants.
text_cn: 友弟德对他们说：“请听我说，我要作一件在我们民族的子孙中万世流芳的事。

text_en: Stand at the town gate tonight so that I may go out with my maid; and within the days after which you have promised to surrender the town to our enemies, the Lord will deliver Israel by my hand.
text_cn: 今夜，你们应站在城门口，我要同我的使女出城，在你们所定要把城池交给敌人的日期内，上主会藉着我的手，眷顾以色列。

text_en: Only, do not try to find out what I am doing; for I will not tell you until I have finished what I am about to do. ”
text_cn: 你们不要侦查我的行动，因为在我要作的事情未完成以前，我不告诉你们。”

text_en: Uzziah and the rulers said to her, “Go in peace, and may the Lord God go before you, to take vengeance on our enemies. ”
text_cn: 敖齐雅与首长对她说：“你平安去罢！愿上主天主引导你报复我们的敌人！”

text_en: So they returned from the tent and went to their posts.
text_cn: 然后他们离开帐幕，回到自己的地方去了。
